def: An 8-bit floating-point encoding with 1 sign bit, 5 exponent bits and 2 mantissa bits that keeps IEEE-style infinities and NaN; its largest magnitude is 57,344.
practice: Its wider range suits gradients, so the common hybrid FP8 recipe uses E4M3 in the forward pass and E5M2 in the backward pass; PyTorch calls it float8_e5m2.
